definitions.explanation: The larval stage of moths and butterflies, especially those covered with hair or bristles. Some species can cause skin irritation.

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{葉|は}に{毛虫|けむし}がいました。
examples.english: There was a caterpillar on the tree leaves.

examples.japanese: {毛虫|けむし}に{触|さわ}ると{痒|かゆ}くなることがあります。
examples.english: Touching caterpillars can sometimes make you itchy.

examples.japanese: {毛虫|けむし}は{蝶|ちょう}か{蛾|が}になります。
examples.english: Caterpillars turn into butterflies or moths.

notes:
{毛虫|けむし} refers specifically to hairy caterpillars.

{毛|け} means "hair" and {虫|むし} means "insect/bug."

Note: Smooth caterpillars without hair are called {芋虫|いもむし} (literally "potato bug").

Caution: Some {毛虫|けむし} have urticating (stinging) hairs that can cause skin irritation or allergic reactions. The {茶毒蛾|ちゃどくが} (tea tussock moth) caterpillar is particularly known for this in Japan.
